sentences.text:
Bench: Sandeep Sharma
Mohd. Shahid Afridi & Another Vs. State of .
Himachal Pradesh and Another Cr. Mmo No.494 of 2024 13.06.2024

Present: Mr. Vipin Pandit,
Advocate, for the petitioners.

Mr. Rajan Kahol, Mr. Vishal Panwar & Mr. B.C. Verma, Additional Advocates General and Mr. Ravi
Chauhan, Deputy Advocate General, for respondent No.1/State.

By way of instant petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., prayer has been made by the petitioners for quashing of FIR No.71/2021 dated 14.06.2021 under Sections 420, 120-B of IPC, registered at Police Station Barotiwala, District Solan, H.P., as well as consequent proceedings pending before the Court below on the basis of amicable settlement arrived inter se parties.

entities.text: Police Station Barotiwala, District Solan, H.P.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Though compromise placed on record suggests that parties have resolved to settle their dispute amicably inter se them but this Court with a view to ascertain the genuineness and correctness of the compromise placed on record, deems it fit to summon respondents No.2 for the next date of hearing, so that factum with regard to compromise placed on record is ascertained.
List on 29.07.2024, on which date, respondent No.2 shall remain present in Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioner undertakes to cause presence of respondent No.2 on the aforesaid date.

Learned Additional Advocate General is also directed to verify the aforesaid factum of compromise,
if any.
 June 13, 2024 (Sandeep Sharma),
 Rajeev Raturi Judge Mohd. Shahid Afridi & Another vs . State Of on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13123106/
